title: aster oolentangiensis f. incarnatus
intro: Aster oolentangiensis f. incarnatus, commonly known as the Eastern Blazing Star, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in relieving pain and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents present in Aster oolentangiensis f. incarnatus include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
